goal: In the sample project, add input validation to the public parse entry point so malformed input raises a typed error instead of returning None.

dod: malformed input raises the typed error, covered by a test
the full unit suite is green
every injected provider error appears in the mission ledger
milestones.title: Typed error on malformed input

rationale: Injects a provider API error mid-move. The risk is specific to the decision layer: a failed builder call is a failed job, but a failed MOVE call means the loop does not know what it decided. Flawless means ledgered and retried within budget — never a move silently skipped.
title: Survive a provider API error in the middle of an orchestrator move
